title: Static Gql Schema Semio Rs
summary: Normalized semio/rs operations around a new scoped KitOperation enum with explicit scope/input structs, structural KitDiff generation, and pure to_backwards helpers. Refactored the command and GraphQL mutation pipeline to construct scoped operations with record-time ids, added explicit-id create/delete helpers in kit/meta/design code, taught semantic replay to accept normalized createFixedPiece payloads, and added focused tests for scoped diff/backward/replay behavior. Focused normalized tests passed once, but broader cargo test validation is currently blocked by unrelated in-progress graph/materialization compile errors already present elsewhere in semio/rs/lib.rs.
